title: Warm Dense Canadian Grass Bowl
description: A hearty Canadian dish featuring dark soy sauce and dashi extract, perfect for a filling meal prep option, with a dense and grassy flavor profile.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil.
Add the quinoa to the saucepan, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the frozen peas and carrots to the skillet and cook until thawed.
In a small bowl, whisk together the dark soy sauce and dashi extract.
Add the soy sauce mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Fluff the cooked quinoa with a fork and add it to the skillet.
Stir in the chopped scallions, grated cheddar cheese, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 10 minutes.
